```{r setup, include=FALSE}
data1 <- read.csv("C:/Users/ETay/Documents/Work documents/CIRCA DIEM/Data/short_term_outcome_data_v0.9.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = TRUE)

 data1 <- data1 %>%
   mutate(nonrand_gp = case_when(study_id == "CD-04011" ~ 1, .default = nonrand_gp)) %>%#intervention to control
   mutate(multiple = case_when(study_id == "CD-04089" ~ 0, .default = multiple)) # identified as a singleton 2026-10-14
 data1 <- data1 %>%
   mutate(Birth_weight_Z = case_when(study_id == "CD-14010" ~ "0.2019", .default = Birth_weight_Z)) %>% #58th centile for weight
   mutate(Birth_HC_Z = case_when(study_id == "CD-14010" ~ "0.5244", .default = Birth_HC_Z)) #70th centile for HC
#Hardcoded due to baby being too young for Fenton Growth Charts
# Used qnorm() function to calculate z-scores

#temp line as this will be changed in the database
data1$romdtm[which(data1$study_id == "CD-03020")] <- "2025-10-28 10:26:00"

possible_formats <- c("dmy", "ymd", "mdy", "dmy HMS", "ymd HMS", "ymd HM")



data <- data1 %>%
  mutate(
         Birth_HC_Z = as.numeric(Birth_HC_Z),
         Birth_weight_Z = as.numeric(Birth_weight_Z),
         b_hc = as.numeric(b_hc),
         bw = as.numeric(bw),
         as1.new = case_when(as1 == "" ~ NA, as1 == "NI" ~ NA, as1 == "UNK" ~ NA, .default = as1),
         as5.new = case_when(as5 == "" ~ NA, as5 == "NI" ~ NA, as5 == "UNK" ~ NA, .default = as5),
         as1.new = as.numeric(as1.new),
         as5.new = as.numeric(as5.new),
         cord_ph = as.numeric(cord_ph),
         IVH_first_final.factor = as.factor(IVH_first_final),
         rand_gp = case_when(study_id == "CD-04011" ~ 1, .default = rand_gp),
         rand_gp = case_when(rand_gp == 2 ~ 0, .default = rand_gp),
         nonrand_gp = case_when(nonrand_gp == 2 ~ 0, .default = nonrand_gp),
         rand_gp = factor(rand_gp, levels = c("0","1"), labels = c("Control","Intervention")),
         nonrand_gp = factor(nonrand_gp, levels = c("0","1"), labels = c("Control", "Intervention")),
         ga_strata.f = ga_strata - 1, #Strata 0 = <28weeks, #Strata 1 = 28-32 Weeks
         chorio = case_when(chor_clin_yn == 1 ~ 1, chor_hist == 1 ~ 2, .default = 0),
         chorio.factor = as.factor(chorio),
         chorio.f.new  = case_when(chorio.factor == "0" ~ "None", chorio.factor == "1" ~ "Clinical", chorio.factor == "2" ~ "Histological"),
         # rand.dfor      = as.Date(parse_date_time(rand_dtm, orders = possible_formats)),
         # dob.dfor       = as.Date(parse_date_time(b_dtm, orders = possible_formats)),
         rand.dtm.correct = case_when(difftime(as.Date(rand_dtm), as.Date(b_dtm), units = "weeks") < 4 ~ rand_dtm,
                           .default = enrol_dtm),
         PNA_rand = difftime(rand.dtm.correct, b_dtm, units = "hours"),
         ans.f = case_when(ans == "" ~ "Unknown",ans == "NI" ~ "Unknown",ans == "0" ~ "Unknown", .default = ans),
         ans.f.new = case_when(ans.f == "1" ~ "None",ans.f == "2" ~ "Incomplete",ans.f == "3" ~ "Complete", ans.f == "4" ~ "Given >7 days before birth", .default = ans.f),
         ans_cat.f = fct_relevel(ans.f.new,"None","Incomplete","Complete","Given >7 days before birth"),
         m_ethnic = case_when(m_ethnic == "1" ~ "African", m_ethnic == "2" ~ "African - American",
                              m_ethnic == "3" ~ "Asian", m_ethnic == "4" ~ "Asian - Indian", 
                              m_ethnic == "5" ~ "European/Causasian", m_ethnic == "6" ~ "Indigenous Australian",
                              m_ethnic == "7" ~ "Torres_Strait Islander", m_ethnic == "8" ~ "Hispanic/Latino",
                              m_ethnic == "9" ~ "MiddleEastern", m_ethnic == "10" ~ "Maori", m_ethnic == "99" ~ "Other",
                              .default = "Unknown"),
         type1.factor = factor(mprob_type___1, levels = c("0","1"), labels = c("No","Yes")),
         type2.factor = factor(mprob_type___2, levels = c("0","1"), labels = c("No","Yes")),
         type3.factor = factor(mprob_type___3, levels = c("0","1"), labels = c("No","Yes")),
         type4.factor = factor(mprob_type___4, levels = c("0","1"), labels = c("No","Yes")),
         type5.factor = factor(mprob_type___5, levels = c("0","1"), labels = c("No","Yes")),
         type6.factor = factor(mprob_type___6, levels = c("0","1"), labels = c("No","Yes")),
         type7.factor = factor(mprob_type___7, levels = c("0","1"), labels = c("No","Yes")),
         delmode = case_when(delmode == "" ~ "Unknown", delmode == "NI" ~ "Unknown",
                             is.na(delmode) ~ "Unknown", .default = delmode),
         delmode = case_when(delmode == "1" ~ "Vaginal", delmode == "2" ~ "Vaginal instrumentation",
                             delmode == "3" ~ "Caesarean", .default = delmode),
         prom = case_when(is.na(romdurn) ~ 0, romdurn == 0 ~ 0, .default = 1), #exclude some values here
         prom.factor = factor(prom, levels = c("0","1"), labels = c("No","Yes")),
         romdtm_new = ifelse(!grepl(":",romdtm), paste(romdtm, "23:59:00"),romdtm),
         b_dtm_new = ifelse(!grepl(":",b_dtm), paste(b_dtm, "23:59:00"),b_dtm),
         romdurn_hr = round(as.numeric(difftime(ymd_hms(romdtm_new),ymd_hms(b_dtm_new), units = "hours")),1),
         romdurn_hr_new = case_when(romdurn_hr > 0 & romdurn_hr < 24 ~ 0, .default = romdurn_hr), #setting all these values to 0 - ROM the same day
         romdurn_day = round(as.numeric(difftime(ymd_hms(romdtm_new),ymd_hms(b_dtm_new), units = "days")),1)
         )

df_multi <- data %>%
  filter(!is.na(birthord)) %>%
  group_by(dob) %>%
  mutate(
    siblings_same_dob = n(),  # Count children with same DOB
    multiple_type = case_when(
      siblings_same_dob == 2 & birthord == 1 ~ "twin",
      siblings_same_dob == 2 & birthord == 2 ~ "twin",
      siblings_same_dob == 3 & birthord == 1 ~ "triplet",
      siblings_same_dob == 3 & birthord == 2 ~ "triplet",
      siblings_same_dob == 3 & birthord == 3~ "triplet",
      siblings_same_dob >= 4 ~ paste0(siblings_same_dob, "-tuple")
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

data2 <- df_multi %>%
  mutate(multiple_type = case_when(study_id %in% c("CD-07024", "CD-07025", "CD-13009","CD-13010","CD-01079",
                                                   "CD-09023", "CD-09024", "CD-01146") ~ "twin", .default = multiple_type)) 
data2 <- data2[,c("study_id","multiple_type")]

data <- data %>%
  left_join(data2, by = "study_id")
         
data_elig <- data %>%
  filter(rand_sib == 1)

data_sib <- data %>%
  filter(rand_sib == 0)

# Data manipulation
data_off <- data %>%
  mutate(
    sex = case_when(
      sex== 0 ~ "Female",
      sex == 1 ~ "Male"
    ),
    sex.factor = factor(sex, levels = c("Female", "Male")),
    multi = case_when(
      multiple == 0 ~ "Singleton",
      multiple_type == "twin" ~ "Twin",
      multiple_type == "triplet" ~ "Triplet",
      .default  = "Unknown"
    ),
    multi.factor = as.factor(multi)
    )

data_sib <- data_sib %>%
  mutate(
    sex = case_when(
      sex== 0 ~ "Female",
      sex == 1 ~ "Male"
    ),
    sex.factor = factor(sex, levels = c("Female", "Male")),
    multi = case_when(
      multiple == 0 ~ "Singleton",
      multiple_type == "twin" ~ "Twin",
      multiple_type == "triplet" ~ "Triplet",
      .default  = "Unknown"
    ),
    multi.factor = as.factor(multi)
    )
```

## Offspring factors - Strata 1 - randomised and eligible
```{r tab.cap="Offspring demographic characteristics - Strata 1", tab.cap.style = "Caption", tab.id = "T1", echo = F}

data_off_rand <- data_off

#data_off_rand$rand_gp.factor = factor(data_off$rand_gp, levels = c("0","1"), labels = c("Control", "Intervention"))

table_demo <- function(data) {
  
  table_out <- data %>%
    filter(rand_sib == 1) %>% 
    filter(ga_strata == 1) %>%
    dplyr::select("sex.factor", "multi.factor", "ga_calc", "PNA_rand", "bw", "Birth_weight_Z","b_hc", 
    "Birth_HC_Z", "as1.new", "as5.new", "cord_ph", "rand_gp", "rand_sib", "ga_strata","IVH_first_final.factor") %>%
    tbl_summary(by = rand_gp,
      percent = "column",  # Show percentages by column for most variables
      missing ="ifany", missing_text = "(Missing)",
      digits = all_categorical() ~ c(0, 0),  # Precision for categorical variables
      type = list(
        sex.factor ~ "categorical",  
        multi.factor ~ "categorical",
        ga_calc ~ "continuous",
        Birth_weight_Z ~ "continuous",
        Birth_HC_Z ~ "continuous",
        as1.new ~ "continuous",
        as5.new ~ "continuous",
        IVH_first_final.factor ~ "categorical",
        all_categorical() ~ "categorical",  # Set all categorical as categorical
        all_continuous() ~ "continuous"  # Set continuous variables
      ),
      statistic = list(
        all_categorical() ~ "{n} / {N} ({p}%)",  # n/N(%) for categorical variables
        all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd}) {median}"#,  # Stats for continuous
       # PARTICIPANT ~ "{n}"  # No percentage for PARTICIPANT variable
      ),
      label = list(sex.factor ~ 'Sex', multi.factor ~ "Multiple birth", ga_calc ~ "Gestational age at birth (weeks PMA)",
        PNA_rand ~ 'PNA at randomisation (hours)',
        bw ~ 'Birth weight (g)', Birth_weight_Z ~ 'Birth weight Z-score',
        b_hc ~ 'Birth head circumference (cm)',         
        Birth_HC_Z ~ 'Birth head circumference Z-score', 
        as1.new ~ 'APGAR score at 1 minute', 
        as5.new ~ 'APGAR score at 5 minutes', 
        cord_ph ~ 'Cord pH',
        IVH_first_final.factor ~ 'IVH Grade prior to enrolment'
      ) 
    ) %>%
        modify_spanning_header(c("stat_1", "stat_2") ~ "**Randomised**") 
  return(table_out)
}

table_demo(data_off_rand)

```

```{r tab.cap="Maternal demographic characteristics - Strata 1", tab.cap.style = "Caption", tab.id = "T4", echo=FALSE}

# Function to generate a table for a specific brand
table_demo_mat_1 <- function(data) {
  
  table_out_mat_1 <- data %>%
    filter(rand_sib == 1) %>% 
    filter(ga_strata == 1) %>%
    dplyr::select("m_ethnic", "type1.factor", "type2.factor", "type3.factor", "type4.factor", "type5.factor","type6.factor", 
    "type7.factor", "chorio.f.new", "ans.f.new", "rand_gp", "romdurn_hr_new", "ga_strata", "prom.factor", "delmode") %>%
    tbl_summary(by = rand_gp,
      percent = "column",  # Show percentages by column for most variables
      missing ="ifany", missing_text = "(Missing)",
      digits = all_categorical() ~ c(0, 0, 1),  # Precision for categorical variables
      type = list(
        m_ethnic ~ "categorical",  # Set PMH as categorical
         type1.factor  ~ "categorical",
        type2.factor  ~ "categorical",
        type3.factor  ~ "categorical",
        type4.factor  ~ "categorical",
        type5.factor  ~ "categorical",
        type6.factor  ~ "categorical",
        type7.factor  ~ "categorical",
        chorio.f.new ~ "categorical",
        ans.f.new ~ "categorical",
        prom.factor ~ "categorical",
        romdurn_hr_new ~ "continuous",
        delmode ~ "categorical",
        all_categorical() ~ "categorical",  # Set all categorical as categorical
        all_continuous() ~ "continuous"  # Set continuous variables
      ),
      statistic = list(
        all_categorical() ~ "{n} / {N} ({p}%)",  # n/N (%) for categorical variables
        all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd}) {median}"#,  # Stats for continuous mean, sd, median
      ),
      label = list(m_ethnic ~ 'Ethnicity', chorio.f.new ~ "Chorioamnionitis", 
                   type1.factor  ~ "Hypertension",
                   type2.factor  ~ "Asthma",
                   type3.factor  ~ "Diabetes",
                   type4.factor  ~ "Hyperthyroidism",
                   type5.factor  ~ "Hypothyroidism",
                   type6.factor  ~ "Epilepsy",
                   type7.factor  ~ "Other",
                   ans.f.new ~ "Use of antenatal steroids",
                   prom.factor ~ 'Premature rupture of membranes',
                   romdurn_hr_new ~ 'Time between PROM and birth (h)',
                   delmode ~ 'Mode of delivery'
      )
    ) 
  return(table_out_mat_1)
}

table_demo_mat_1(data)
```
